title: Beechcraft Bonanza V35B — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Beechcraft Bonanza V35B with Continental IO-520 fuel-injected engine, constant-speed propeller, and retractable tricycle gear. The V35B features the distinctive V-tail (butterfly tail) with ruddervator surfaces that combine rudder and elevator function; pilots transitioning from conventional-tail aircraft should seek qualified instruction. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, manifold pressure limits, RPM settings, and performance data must come from the specific aircraft POH. Not a substitute for qualified instruction or type-specific training.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, manifold pressure limits, or other numerical limitations — all must come from the specific aircraft POH.
Equipment, avionics, and fuel system configurations vary across V35B airframes. Verify every item against the specific aircraft and its POH before use.

rights.notes: Manufacturer POH remains under copyright. This file does not reproduce its wording or selection of items.
